relationships.subject: atogepant
relationships.evidence_quote: At three months, 29.7% of patients achieved a ≥ 50% reduction in MMD.

relationships.subject: anti-CGRP monoclonal antibodies
relationships.evidence_quote: A higher number of previously failed MAbs was independently associated with reduced odds of ≥ 50% response (RR 0.79, 95% CI 0.64 to 0.97).

key_findings: In 252 patients failing anti-CGRP mAbs, atogepant gave a 29.7% >=50% response rate at 3 months.
More previously failed mAbs predicted lower atogepant response.
